proposals.why: Catherine mocks Juliana’s “legacy” then abruptly asks “Your scarred soldier?” leaving a tense, unanswered question about the mysterious husband.

Catherine threatens Juliana’s death (“And when they find your corpse…”) and then challenges her husband’s power with “What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?” – a daring question that stops the scene.
The clip opens with Juliana being violently forced forward, then builds to Catherine’s chilling warning “The magistrate will call it witchcraft,” a threat that leaves the audience hanging.
